The '''Imperial Navy Yard''' was a ground-based [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]] located in [[Tasariq City]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tasariq]]. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire's]] [[Imperial Army/Legends|Army]] and [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Navy]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], [[Transport/Legends|transports]] and patrol craft were stationed and maintained in the Imperial Navy Yard.<ref name="J15" />
